method: A compiled historical timeline, not one survey's microdata - each point is a separately cited Church-reported (or Church-published rounded) figure, spaced irregularly across 1940-2025 rather than on a fixed annual grid. No point is interpolated or estimated: years with no findable real figure (most of 1940-2024 outside the points listed here) are simply omitted rather than filled in. See each year's own `source`.
